bull.b: Effectively zero debt and a materially larger equity base reduce refinancing and interest-cost risk for a development-stage biotech. This durable capital structure gives Tenax more optionality to fund clinical activities and negotiate partner terms over the next several quarters.

A primary manufacturing supply deal plus an extended U.S. approval deadline materially lowers execution and timeline risk for commercialization. Defined forecasting, quality and cost-sharing terms support reliable scale-up and reduce a common bottleneck for launch-readiness.
